name: ADQ
verdict: ADQ is an Abu Dhabi investment and holding company; Abu Dhabi's Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs consolidated its assets under the sovereign fund L'IMAD in January 2026.
note: Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company; its mark is on the sleeves of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG jersey (kit launched 12 December 2025). Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. The sponsor is an Abu Dhabi state holding company, now under L'IMAD, a sovereign fund of the Government of Abu Dhabi. The UAE's record is on main (uae-mass-trial-2024, mubadala-uae-convictions-upheld).
